title: SIDESTORY: THE MASSES' TRAVELS OPEN
lines: 01 SIDESTORY: THE MASSES' TRAVELS OPEN
DURATION: October 14, 2025, 08:00 - November 11, 2025, 03:59 (UTC-7)
UNLOCK REQUIREMENT: Clear Main Storyline 1-10
DETAILS: The Masses' Travels event stages will be open for a limited time. Players can obtain event rewards by clearing event stages, completing the event missions, and redeeming from Event Store.
Event Stages will open in 3 phases:
- Phase 1 [A Glance at the Shrine]
DURATION: October 14, 2025, 08:00 - November 4, 2025, 03:59 (UTC-7)
- Phase 2 [An Audience with God]
DURATION: October 21, 2025, 16:00 - November 4, 2025, 03:59 (UTC-7)
- Phase 3 [Rest in Peace]
DURATION: October 28, 2025, 16:00 - November 4, 2025, 03:59 (UTC-7)
[A Firearm Technician's Night]
DETAILS: During the event, players can complete the orders in [A Firearm Technician's Night] to collect the rewards and daily earnings.
REWARDS: Firearms Workshop Giftbox (use to randomly obtain a specified upgrade material), Module Materials, Elite Materials, LMD, Battle Records, etc.
Note:
The gunsmithy coffee pot will brew 2 cups of Espresso every day at 04:00 (UTC-7). Accepting an order requires 1 Espresso. 2 Espressos are automatically obtained when you unlock the gunsmithy.
[Babysitting Criteria]
DETAILS: During the event, players can complete [Babysitting Criteria] missions by clearing event stages to gain rewards.
REWARDS: [★★★★★ ★ : Sankta Miksaparato], Paganini's Firearms Workshop Furniture (Pieces), Module Materials, Enlightened Pacifier, etc.
[Sweet Dream Hall]
DURATION: October 14, 2025, 08:00 - November 11, 2025, 03:59 (UTC-7)

DETAILS: During the event, players can obtain Enlightened Pacifier by clearing event stages and completing [Babysitting Criteria]. Enlightened Pacifier can be used to redeem items from [Sweet Dream Hall].

REWARDS: Sankta Miksaparato's tokens, Paganini's Firearms Workshop Furniture (Pieces), Headhunting Permits, MARTHE Sports Line - Rest Between Sets for Broca, Test Collection Series - Fresh Fastener for Amiya, Module Materials, Elite Materials, LMD, Battle Records, etc.
Note:
During this event, the event stories cannot be reviewed in [Public Affairs]. After the event ends, this event will be included in [Public Affairs].
02 LIMITED HEADHUNTING OPEN – FREEDOM OF PREACH
DURATION: October 14, 2025, 08:00 - October 28, 2025, 03:59 (UTC-7)

DETAILS: During the Limited Headhunting, [Freedom of Preach], the following Operators will appear at a higher rate: ★★★★★★: Exusiai the New Covenant [Limited] / Lemuen ★★★★★★: Wiš'adel [Limited] / Virtuosa [Limited] / Muelsyse [Limited]
★★★★★: Gracebearer

In this [Limited Headhunting], players will get the limited Operator Exusiai the New Covenant after a total of 300 rolls (once only) . This special 6-star Operator is a bonus gift that does not give [Headhunting Data Contracts], and does not affect the chance to get next 6-star Operator in this [Limited Headhunting]. This count is reset at the end of this [Limited Headhunting].
Note:
- [Freedom of Preach] is part of the [Limited Headhunting - Celebration] headhunting series.
- [Limited Headhunting - Celebration] is Limited Headhunting.
- Lemuen and Gracebearer will become available in [Standard Headhunting] after October 28, 2025, 04:00 (UTC-7).

- Operator Skadi the Corrupting Heart will be available in the [Headhunting Data Contract Shop] during [Limited Headhunting - Celebration]. The required Headhunting Data Contracts for Skadi the Corrupting Heart will be reduced from 300 to 200 starting this headhunting.
Available Operators from the current [Headhunting Data Contract Shop]:
★★★★★★ (300 Headhunting Data Contract): Exusiai the New Covenant / Lemuen / Wiš'adel / Virtuosa / Muelsyse / Texas the Omertosa / Specter the Unchained / Nearl the Radiant Knight
★★★★★★ (200 Headhunting Data Contract): Skadi the Corrupting Heart / Rosmontis / W
★★★★★ (75 Headhunting Data Contract): Gracebearer
- Exusiai the New Covenant is currently ONLY available from the [Limited Headhunting - Celebration], and is NOT available in any Standard Headhunting.
- Please refer to the official notice of this Limited Headhunting for more details.
03 DAILY FREE ROLL IN [FREEDOM OF PREACH] LIMITED HEADHUNTING
DURATION: October 14, 2025, 08:00 - October 28, 2025, 03:59 (UTC-7)
DETAILS: A free roll can be performed every day during the event in [Freedom of Preach] Limited Headhunting.
Note:
- Daily Free Roll will be refreshed at 04:00 (UTC-7) every day.
- Daily Free Roll can only be used once a day and will not accumulate.
04 2025 CELEBRATION SIGN-IN EVENT OPEN
DURATION: October 14, 2025, 08:00 - October 28, 2025, 03:59 (UTC-7)

DETAILS: During the event, players can log in for 10 days to receive generous rewards, including Examplary Believer Headhunting Permit, Exclusive Outfit for PhonoR-0, [★: CONFESS-47], Reception Room Functional Furniture (Pinboard), Interactable Furniture, and more.
Day 1: Examplary Believer Headhunting Permit * 1, Emergency Sanity Concentrate * 1
Day 2: Recruitment Permit * 5, Operator [★: CONFESS-47]
Day 3: LMD * 30000, Module Data Block * 1
Day 4: Tactical Battle Record * 20, Reception Room Functional Furniture - 'Strawberry flavor, please!'
Day 5: Orundum * 200, Expedited Plan * 5
Day 6: Skill Summary - 2 * 20, Chip Catalyst * 1
Day 7: Pure Gold * 20, Bloodline of Combat Collection - Primordial Ode for PhonoR-0
Day 8: Orundum * 200, Data Supplement Stick * 10
Day 9: Skill Summary - 3 * 8, Interactable Furniture - 'CONFESS (Replica)'
Day 10: Orundum * 200, Data Supplement Instrument * 3
Note:
- Examplary Believer Headhunting Permit can only be used to perform a 10-roll in [Freedom of Preach] Limited Headhunting.
- Examplary Believer Headhunting Permit expires on October 28, 2025, 03:59 (UTC-7)
- Please refer to the in-game info for the expiration time of the Emergency Sanity Concentrate from this event.
05 SHRINE OF NURTURY WISH BOARD OPEN
DURATION: October 14, 2025, 08:00 - October 28, 2025, 03:59 (UTC-7)

DETAILS: During the event, players can get two trials for Wishing Tickets each day upon login. Consume trials to select Wishing Tickets as permitted in [Shrine of Nurtury Wish Board]. The Lucky Strip with the most Orundum will be awarded. Both trials for the day must be used before claiming the reward.
Note:
- There are 14 days at most for players to pick Wishing Tickets.
- Players will randomly obtain following amount of Orundum from Wishing Tickets:
Orundum * 200, Orundum * 300, Orundum * 400, Orundum * 500, Orundum * 600, Orundum * 800

- If the amount of Orundum in daily reward is less than 400 (400 is NOT included), players will be granted an extra trial the next day. The extra trial cannot be accumulated, players can get 3 daily trials at most (including the extra trial).
- All the daily trials will be refreshed at 04:00 (UTC-7) on the next day and cannot be accumulated.
06 NEW OPERATORS NOW AVAILABLE
★★★★★★: Exusiai the New Covenant [Limited]
★★★★★★: Lemuen
★★★★★★: Sankta Miksaparato
★★★★★: Gracebearer
★: CONFESS-47
DETAILS:
- Exusiai the New Covenant is currently ONLY available from the [Limited Headhunting - Celebration], and is NOT available in any [Standard Headhunting].

- Operator Sankta Miksaparato is currently ONLY available from The Masses' Travels event, and is NOT available in [Freedom of Preach] Limited Headhunting, [Standard Headhunting] or [Kernel Headhunting].
- Operators Lemuen and Gracebearer will become available in [Standard Headhunting] after October 28, 2025, 04:00 (UTC-7).
- From October 14, 2025, 08:00 to November 4, 2025, 03:59 (UTC-7), Operators Exusiai the New Covenant, Lemuen, Sankta Miksaparato, Gracebearer and CONFESS-47 will gain more trust in the event stages.
07 DUEL CHANNEL: GREEN GRASSVILLE OPEN
STAGE DURATION: October 14, 2025, 08:00 - October 30, 2025, 03:59 (UTC-7)
UNLOCK REQUIREMENT: Clear Main Storyline 1-10

DETAILS: During the event, players can earn [Grand Duel Fireworks] by participating in event stages and completing daily activities, and level up the [Grassville Program] to receive corresponding event rewards.
[Grassville Program]
OPEN TIME: October 14, 2025, 08:00 - November 2, 2025, 03:59 (UTC-7)
REWARDS: Event Furniture, Event Avatar, Module Materials, Elite Materials, LMD, Battle Records, and more.
- For detailed event information, please stay tuned to our official social media.
08 AUTO DEPLOY UPDATE
UPDATE TIME: October 14, 2025, 08:00 (UTC-7)

DETAILS: After the update on October 14, 2025, 08:00 (UTC-7), Auto Deploy will update to Auto Deploy+. Players can adjust how many Sanity will be consumed to multiply the rewards obtained in one operation.
Note:
After the update on October 14, 2025, 08:00 (UTC-7), the Squad system will also support a Branch filtering feature.
09 NEW CUMULATIVE SIGN-IN UPDATE
UPDATE TIME: October 14, 2025, 08:00 (UTC-7)

DETAILS: After the update on October 14, 2025, 08:00 (UTC-7), a new cumulative sign-in system will be introduced. When the Doctor's level reaches lv.80 and the corresponding number of sign-in days is completed, outfits and dynamic icons can be unlocked: signing in for 180 days and 360 days will grant the dynamic avatars 'Organization' and 'Emotion' respectively; signing in for 1000 days will unlock the dynamic outfit [Test Collection Series - Moonlit Voyage for Kroos]. This outfit comes alive with multiple dynamic illustrations, form-changing, and special actions.
10 ACTIVITY ROOM & BASE UPDATE
UPDATE TIME: October 14, 2025, 08:00 (UTC-7)

DETAILS: After the update on October 14, 2025, 08:00 (UTC-7), three new activity rooms will be added. In addition, Friend Base visits will be smoother, and it will be eaisier for players to locate their assistant operators.

18 INTEGRATED LOOKBACK: BACK TO CASTLE OPEN
DURATION: October 14, 2025, 08:00 - October 28, 2025, 03:59 (UTC-7)
UNLOCK REQUIREMENT: Clear Main Storyline 1-10

DETAILS: After the update on October 14, 08:00 (UTC-7), Integrated Strategies: Phantom and Crimson Solitaire will include Silent Squad and difficulties ranging from 0 to 15; Additionally, during the event period, players can earn 'Strategist' Points by completing Daily Missions and Limited-Time Missions. Accumulating certain 'Strategist' Points will grant Rhodes Island Supplies VIII rewards.
Note:

Players who have not completed <Formal Investigation> before the update can start challenges from difficulty level 3 after the update; those who have completed <Formal Investigation> before the update can start from difficulty level 6; and those who have completed <Calamity Faceoff> before the update can begin challenges from difficulty level 9.
